_about: The permanent cast of GetYr Studio. Every series uses ONLY these characters, so they always look and sound the same. Edit freely: color (orange blue red green yellow purple white pink), shape (box round tall), accessory (none cap goggles bowtie headphones scarf), voice = an Edge TTS voice name.

characters.name: Turbo
characters.personality: young, fearless, impatient underdog racing driver who talks fast and dreams big
characters.want: to prove a small family team can beat the champions

characters.name: Gramps
characters.personality: old retired champion, now Turbo's chief mechanic; calm, wise, dry humour
characters.want: to see Turbo win the right way
characters.flaw: hides an old secret about his last race
characters.catchphrase: Races are won in the garage, kid.

characters.name: Pixel
characters.personality: tiny, cheerful race engineer and data genius; funny and loyal
characters.want: to be taken seriously by the grown-up bots

characters.name: Vega
characters.personality: elegant, ice-cold reigning champion of the rich Apex team; secretly lonely
characters.want: to stay number one at any cost
characters.flaw: pride; can't admit she is afraid to lose
characters.catchphrase: Second place is just the first loser.

characters.name: Brick
characters.personality: big, scheming owner of the Apex team who bends the rules
characters.want: to buy the championship and shut down small teams

characters.name: Sky
characters.personality: warm race commentator and Turbo's best friend; brave and honest
characters.want: to tell the true story of the championship
characters.catchphrase: And what a moment this is!

characters.name: Nitro
characters.personality: funny, reckless driver who switches sides; chaotic but good-hearted

characters.name: Rosa
characters.personality: brilliant new rookie driver, quiet, determined, mysterious past
characters.want: to find out who she really is
